jobs.description:
**Product Management At Dalux – Built On Real Construction Experience

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and we're looking for a Product Manager with something particularly important for our Field product: deep knowledge of how construction actually happens on site.

Dalux Field is used every day by contractors, subcontractors, site managers, quality managers, safety professionals, and other construction professionals around the world.

To continue improving these products, we want even more real-world construction experience within our Product organization.

You might already be working in Product Management or construction technology. But you might also currently be a Site Manager, Construction Manager, Project Manager, BIM/VDC Manager, Digital Construction specialist, or similar and be interested in using your industry experience to improve the digital tools used across construction.

For this role, deep construction knowledge and a strong product mindset are more important than previous Product Manager experience.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• Product Discovery: Identify and understand problems experienced by construction professionals and turn them into product opportunities.

• Customer Insights: Spend time with customers and users to understand how work is actually performed on construction sites – not just how processes are supposed to work.

• Domain Expertise: Bring practical construction knowledge into Product and Development and challenge assumptions about real-world workflows.

• Feature Ownership: Lead new capabilities from initial problem discovery through development, release, and validation with users.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with developers, Product Designers, and fellow Product Managers to translate complex construction processes into simple digital experiences.

• Product Prioritization: Balance customer needs, strategic opportunities, technical feasibility, and business impact when deciding what we should build.

• Product Strategy: Help shape the future direction of Dalux Field and identify where technology can fundamentally improve how construction work is performed.

**About You

**Unlike many Product Manager positions, we don't require you to already be an experienced Product Manager .

What we care deeply about is your understanding of construction.

We believe you:

• Have significant practical experience from construction projects, preferably working close to the construction site.

• Understand the everyday workflows of contractors, subcontractors, site managers, and other on-site stakeholders.

• Have experience with areas such as quality assurance, inspections, defects, health & safety, site coordination, documentation, progress, or similar construction processes.

• Understand the difference between how construction processes are designed and how people actually work on site.

• Are passionate about improving construction through digitalization.

• Are curious, analytical, and naturally interested in understanding why problems occur rather than simply accepting existing processes.

• Can communicate effectively with both construction professionals and technically oriented colleagues.

• Are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Previous Product Management or software-development experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

If you have spent years using construction software and regularly found yourself thinking "surely there must be a better way to do this" , this might be an opportunity to help build that better way.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

About this opportunity

As part of Getinge's Acute Care Therapies (ACT) business area, you will join a team dedicated to improving outcomes for critically ill patients through innovative cardiovascular solutions. The Danish ACT Cardiovascular team is responsible for supporting hospitals and healthcare professionals with advanced technologies used in cardiac surgery and critical care environments.

We are now looking for an Account Manager to join our team in Denmark. This is a replacement recruitment for a well-established territory, offering the opportunity to further develop customer relationships and drive growth within a highly specialized product portfolio. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across the Nordic region, including Sales, Service, Product Management, Finance, and Back Office functions.

In this role, your primary responsibility will be to develop and grow sales of Getinge's ACT Cardiovascular portfolio across Denmark while acting as a trusted partner to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.

**

What you will do**

As Account Manager, you will combine commercial responsibility with clinical customer support, helping healthcare providers optimize patient care through our solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

• Driving sales growth of the ACT Cardiovascular portfolio across Denmark.

• Building and developing long-term relationships with surgeons, cardiologists, perfusionists, nurses, purchasing departments, and hospital management.

• Providing product expertise and clinical support during customer interactions and evaluations.

• Managing tender processes and commercial opportunities within your territory.

• Maintaining accurate sales forecasting and CRM reporting while ensuring compliance with Getinge's quality standards and processes.

This position is home-based in Denmark and requires regular travel throughout the country, as well as occasional international travel. The role offers a high degree of flexibility and autonomy while remaining closely connected to the Nordic ACT organization.

You will bring

To be successful in this position, we believe you have:

• Experience in medical technology sales, or a combination of clinical and commercial experience within MedTech.

• Proven experience working with hospitals, healthcare professionals, or healthcare organizations.

• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience using CRM systems and strong general IT proficiency.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively within Denmark.

Meritorious qualifications include:

• Experience within perfusion, cardiac surgery or vascular surgery.

• Experience supporting complex medical technologies in clinical settings.

• Knowledge of public procurement and tender processes.

• Experience working in an international or Nordic matrix organization.

In addition to your professional background, we value individuals who are self-driven, collaborative, structured, and customer-focused. You enjoy creating trusted relationships, take ownership of your territory, and thrive in an environment where commercial success and patient outcomes go hand in hand.

At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers.

We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.

**

Why join Getinge**

Getinge offers a job in a safe and informal work environment, where we appreciate close team collaboration. We keep an open dialogue between leaders and employees, as well as between teams. We are focused on developing people, and together we will create a plan for learning and competence development when you start your career with us.

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 01-11-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

#LI-JM2

About us

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer for Financial and Non-Financial Risk Areas
jobs.description:
**About The Role

**Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas?

If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo.

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk as well as non-financial areas such as operational risk, model risk and strategic risks in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc.

However, if you are curious about the other areas covered by the team, we will help you develop your skills and knowledge within these areas.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform compliance risk assessments

• Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

**Your profile

**We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas.

**Further We Expect You To Have

**

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation.

It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’.

You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Oliver Wyman – Senior Consultant- (m/f/d) – Stockholm or Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

**As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

**

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

**Experience Rewards That Work For You

**

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

**Who can apply?

**We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

**Required Qualifications

**

• 3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

• Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.

• Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.

• Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.

• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.

• Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language

• Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

**Nice to have

**

• Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.

• CFA or equivalent professional certification.

• MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

**What we're looking for?

**Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.

• Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

**How to apply?

**Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

**What to expect during the interviews process?

**At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.
